font.note: draw each glyph's 12x16 cell at the pen position, then move the pen by the advance. The colour is already baked in (dark brown on a light edge).

panels.note: stack them at the top left, for example at y = 8 and y = 44. Time: 00:00.00 left aligned at textOrigin (77 px wide). Distance: e.g. 123m, left aligned or right aligned to rightAlignX.
